turnover.title: Turnover by currency
notes: No FX rate ships with the data, so no figure crosses a currency (ADR-0001). Spain and Peru are separate tracks.
1,366 betslips carry no currency: counted everywhere, summed nowhere.
Leg-grain turnover runs above betslip grain because a combined bet repeats its stake on every leg — the ratio differs by track (EUR bets combine more than PEN bets).
